name: Tamreena Tashfeen
description: Tamreena led the overall direction and development of Atlas After Blue. She formed and coordinated the team, selected the NASA Space Apps Challenge problem, assigned responsibilities, and guided the project's development. She designed and developed the website, built and organized its pages, and integrated the team's research, geospatial outputs, analysis, and documentation into one platform. She also handled the website's visual identity, branding, user experience, content organization, and overall presentation, making key product decisions throughout the project.

name: Syed Saim Ali
description: Syed Saim Ali developed the NISAR GCOV processing pipeline to process satellite datasets using NASA's ASF Search API. His work included satellite-scene selection, pre-event and post-event data checks, HDF5 processing, area-of-interest extraction, raster alignment, and backscatter change calculations. He analyzed the processed satellite imagery, implemented rule-based candidate flood and anomaly classification, and prepared the final geospatial outputs and processed data, delivering them to the Project Lead for integration into the platform.

name: Mamuna Ahmad
description: Mamuna Ahmad led the research activities for Atlas After Blue. She conducted research on previous NASA Space Apps Challenge projects, relevant case studies, target audiences, and other areas supporting the project's concept and development. She also proposed project names and contributed ideas for its identity, which were reviewed and finalized by the Project Lead. Additionally, she reviewed the documented processing methodology, cross-checked case-study reports against exported results, supported the refinement of flood-detection conditions through research and validation, and prepared the presentation slides for the final project submission.

name: Ayan Touqeer
description: Ayan Touqeer supported team collaboration by setting up and managing the shared ClickUp workspace, providing team members with access, and preparing a demonstration video explaining its use. He also provided technical assistance during discussions about project data and image-format requirements, helping team members share project materials and coordinate their work.

name: Sharmeen Shahid
description: Sharmeen Shahid analyzed the team’s processed outputs and case-study documents and prepared the Upper Kohistan flash flood case-study report for Atlas After Blue. Her structured PDF documents the July 2026 event, data timeline, and detection method, and presents the results, limitations, and next steps with appropriate caution for the final submission.
